theme: ❄️ Snow Day! Shinkansen to GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort (Sledding & Snow Fun)

hotel.notes: Tokyo hotel stay; no luggage transfer required today!

activities.title: Hotel Tavinos Asakusa ➔ Tokyo / Ueno Station
activities.stationWalk: Ginza Line 3 stops to Ueno (5 min) ➔ Walk 3 min to Shinkansen gates
activities.transitSummary: Subway Ginza Line 5 min to Ueno Station (¥180)
activities.note: Walk 6 min to Tokyo Metro Asakusa Station ➔ Board Ginza Line 3 stops direct to Ueno Station (5 min, ¥180). Walk through underground concourse (3 min) to JR Ueno Station Shinkansen Ticket Gate (or continue 3 stops to Tokyo Station).

simplifiedBullets.text: Walk 6 min to Asakusa Station ➔ Take Ginza Line 3 stops direct to Ueno (5 min, ¥180).
Walk through underground passage (3 min) to JR Ueno Shinkansen gates (Platform 19/20).

activities.title: Tokyo / Ueno ➔ GALA Yuzawa (Joetsu Shinkansen)
activities.stationWalk: Board Platform 19/20 at Ueno ➔ 75 min direct through Alps tunnel
activities.transitSummary: JR Joetsu Shinkansen (75 min direct, ~¥7,000 / JR Pass)
activities.note: Board JR Joetsu Shinkansen Tanigawa (Platform 19/20 at Ueno, or 20–23 at Tokyo). Speed north through Saitama and Gunma, then pass through the 22.2km Daishimizu Tunnel beneath the snow-capped Tanigawa mountain range straight into GALA Yuzawa Station (75 min direct, ~¥7,000 pp or covered by JR Tokyo Wide Pass).

simplifiedBullets.text: Board Joetsu Shinkansen Tanigawa; speed through Tanigawa mountain range (75 min direct).
Train arrives directly inside the GALA Yuzawa ski center terminal!

activities.title: GALA Yuzawa Snow Resort (Gondola, Sledding & Play)
activities.transitMethod: Direct inside station! (0 min walk) + Gondola
activities.stationWalk: Train platform exits directly inside ski rental concourse (0 min walk!)
activities.transitSummary: Direct ski terminal inside station • Gondola to Cheers area
activities.note: The train platform exits directly inside the GALA Yuzawa Ski Center (Cowabunga Station)! No bus or walking required. Rent snow boots, gloves, and sleds on 2F. Board the 8-person Diligence Gondola right inside the terminal up to the mountain alpine area (Cheers, 800m elevation). Sled down snow slopes, take photos against snow peaks, and enjoy hot cocoa.

simplifiedBullets.text: Ride 8-seater Diligence Gondola up to Central Area (800m summit) with rental snow gear.
Enjoy sledding slopes, snow play park, observation deck, and warm mountain cafe.

activities.title: Gondola Down to GALA Yuzawa Concourse
activities.stationWalk: Gondola ride down to ski center concourse & Shinkansen gates
activities.transitSummary: Gondola ride down to station ticket gates
activities.note: Ride the Diligence Gondola down to the base terminal. Return rental gear, browse Niigata rice cracker and souvenir stalls, and proceed to the Shinkansen gates.

simplifiedBullets.text: Take gondola back down to base terminal; return rental boots and jackets.
Browse Niigata local rice snacks, sake chocolates, and prepare for Shinkansen.

activities.title: GALA Yuzawa ➔ Tokyo (Return Joetsu Shinkansen)
activities.stationWalk: 75 min direct return bullet train to Ueno/Tokyo
activities.transitSummary: JR Joetsu Shinkansen (75 min direct return, ~¥7,000 / JR Pass)
activities.note: Board return Joetsu Shinkansen at GALA Yuzawa Station (Platform 1/2) ➔ Ride 75 min direct back to Ueno Station (17:15) or Tokyo Station (17:28).

simplifiedBullets.text: Board return Shinkansen Tanigawa direct from GALA Yuzawa Station back to Ueno (75 min).
Relax in spacious reclining seats as you transition from snow alps back to Tokyo.

activities.transitSummary: Subway Ginza Line 5 min ➔ Walk 6 min to hotel
activities.note: Transfer at Ueno Station to Tokyo Metro Ginza Line ➔ Ride 3 stops to Asakusa Station (5 min, ¥180) ➔ Walk 6 min back to Hotel Tavinos Asakusa.

simplifiedBullets.text: Take Ginza Line 3 stops from Ueno to Asakusa (5 min, ¥180) ➔ Walk 4 min to hotel.
Drop snow gear, shower, change, and recharge before dinner.

activities.note: Walk 5 min (400m) from hotel to Gyumon Asakusa for Halal-certified grilled beef and piping hot beef ramen.

simplifiedBullets.text: Walk 6 min into Asakusa culinary quarter to Gyumon.
Warm up with tender grilled Halal beef cuts and rich hot beef ramen after a snowy day.

activities.note: Walk 6 min to Asakusa Station ➔ Board Toei Asakusa Line 1 stop to Kuramae, transfer to Toei Oedo Line direct to Shinjuku Station (22 min, ¥280) ➔ Take New South Gate elevator up to 4F Busta Shinjuku (Shinjuku Expressway Bus Terminal).

simplifiedBullets.text: Take Asakusa Line 1 stop to Kuramae, transfer to Oedo Line to Shinjuku (22 min, ¥280).
Take New South Gate elevator directly up to 4F Busta Shinjuku expressway bus gates.

activities.title: Shinjuku ➔ Mt. Fuji / Kawaguchiko (Direct Highway Coach)
activities.stationWalk: Board Busta 4F ➔ 1h 45m direct scenic coach to Kawaguchiko Station
activities.transitSummary: Direct Highway Coach (1h 45m, ¥2,200 / ~RM 65 pp)
activities.note: Board Chuo Highway Express Bus from Busta Shinjuku Platform (Depart 08:45) direct to Kawaguchiko Station (1h 45m scenic mountain drive along Chuo Expressway, ¥2,200 / ~RM 65 pp). Guaranteed reserved seating, USB charging, and luggage hold beneath coach.

simplifiedBullets.text: Board Chuo Highway Express Coach from Busta Shinjuku (depart 08:45, ¥2,200).
1h 45m scenic mountain drive with reserved seats, USB chargers, and luggage hold.

activities.title: Chureito Pagoda (Arakurayama Sengen Park)
activities.stationWalk: Train 4 stops to Shimoyoshida ➔ Walk 8 min (550m) + climb 398 steps
activities.transitSummary: Train to Shimoyoshida (12 min, ¥310) ➔ Walk 8 min + climb 398 steps
activities.note: At Kawaguchiko Station, board local Fujikyu Railway train 4 stops to Shimoyoshida Station (12 min, ¥310) ➔ Exit Shimoyoshida Station, walk 8 min (550m) east through peaceful residential lane to park entrance ➔ Climb the 398 stone steps up to the iconic 5-story vermilion Chureito Pagoda framing the snow-capped summit of Mount Fuji.

simplifiedBullets.text: Fujikyu Railway 4 stops to Shimoyoshida (12 min, ¥310) ➔ Walk 8 min through village.
Climb 398 steps to Japan's most famous viewpoint: red pagoda framing snow-capped Mt. Fuji!

activities.title: Shimoyoshida ➔ Lake Kawaguchi (Return Train)
activities.stationWalk: Walk 8 min to Shimoyoshida ➔ Train 12 min to Kawaguchiko Station
activities.transitSummary: Train back to Kawaguchiko Station (12 min, ¥310)
activities.note: Walk 8 min back down to Shimoyoshida Station ➔ Board Fujikyu Railway train back to Kawaguchiko Station (12 min, ¥310).

simplifiedBullets.text: Walk 8 min down to Shimoyoshida Station ➔ Board train back to Kawaguchiko Station (12 min, ¥310).
Head to Platform 1 for the Lake Kawaguchiko Retro Bus.

activities.title: Lake Kawaguchi & Oishi Park (Fuji Reflection Promenade)
activities.stationWalk: Retro Bus Platform 1 (25 min) ➔ Terminus Stop #20 Oishi Park
activities.transitSummary: Kawaguchiko Sightseeing Bus Red Line (25 min, ¥500)
activities.note: Board Kawaguchiko Sightseeing Retro Bus (Red Line) from Platform 1 at Kawaguchiko Station ➔ Ride along northern shore of Lake Kawaguchi to terminus stop #20 Oishi Park (25 min, ¥500). Stroll the lakeside flower promenade facing Mt. Fuji directly across the water. Browse Mt. Fuji souvenirs and soft-serve ice cream.

simplifiedBullets.text: Board Red Line Retro Bus to terminus stop #20 Oishi Park (25 min, ¥500).
Stroll along the waterfront promenade with grand, crystal-clear views of Mt. Fuji across the lake.

activities.transitSummary: Direct Highway Coach to Shinjuku (1h 45m, ¥2,200 / ~RM 65 pp)
activities.note: Ride Red Line bus back to Kawaguchiko Station (25 min) ➔ Board return Chuo Highway Express Bus (16:30 departure) direct back to Busta Shinjuku (1h 45m, ¥2,200).

simplifiedBullets.text: Bus back to Kawaguchiko Station ➔ Board 16:30 Chuo Highway Express Coach to Shinjuku (1h 45m, ¥2,200).
Direct return to 4F Busta Shinjuku terminal right into Tokyo.

simplifiedBullets.text: Take JR Yamanote Line from Shinjuku to Kanda ➔ Ginza Line to Asakusa (25 min, ¥350).
Enjoy a hearty Halal hotpot or yakiniku dinner after a brisk day in the Fuji winter air.

activities.note: Walk 6 min to Asakusa Station ➔ Board Toei Asakusa Line 1 stop to Kuramae, transfer to Toei Oedo Line to Shinjuku-nishiguchi Station (22 min, ¥280) ➔ Take Exit D3, walk 5 min (400m) east through vibrant Kabukicho pedestrian arcade to Hotel Gracery Shinjuku.

simplifiedBullets.text: Asakusa Line to Kuramae, transfer to Oedo Line to Shinjuku-nishiguchi Station (22 min, ¥280).
Exit D3; stroll 5 min through Kabukicho arcade directly to Hotel Gracery.

activities.transitSummary: Life-sized roaring Godzilla Head terrace photo stop
activities.note: Take elevator to 8F lobby terrace of Hotel Gracery Shinjuku. Stand face-to-face with the life-sized, roaring Godzilla Head roaring over the Shinjuku skyline (roars with smoke and red light effects on the hour!).

simplifiedBullets.text: Take elevator up to 8F outdoor lobby terrace of Hotel Gracery Shinjuku.
Stand face-to-face with the iconic giant Godzilla head peering over the skyline.

activities.transitSummary: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (14 min direct, ¥180 / ~RM 5 pp)

simplifiedBullets.text: Board JR Chuo-Sobu Yellow Line at Shinjuku Platform 13/16 direct to Akihabara (14 min, ¥180).
Exit via Electric Town Gate (Denki-gai) right into the anime and tech hub plaza.

activities.transitMethod: Walk (1 min from Electric Town Exit!)

activities.transitSummary: Walk 1 min directly from Electric Town Exit into Yodobashi
activities.note: Step directly out from Electric Town Exit into Radio Kaikan, Mandarake, and Animate anime/gaming towers. Walk 1 min across the plaza into Yodobashi Camera Multimedia Akiba (9 massive floors of electronics, camera lenses, noise-canceling headphones, handheld consoles, and duty-free tech).

simplifiedBullets.text: Explore multi-level anime figure shops, retro games, and gachapon alleys at Radio Kaikan.
Browse Yodobashi Camera Multimedia Akiba across 9 massive floors of electronics and gadgets.

activities.title: Don Quijote Akihabara (Souvenirs & Tax-Free)

activities.note: Walk 4 min (300m) north along main Chuo-dori avenue to Don Quijote Akihabara (5 floors of discount Japanese snacks, matcha KitKats, cosmetics, skincare, novelty goods, and duty-free checkout on top floor).

simplifiedBullets.text: Walk 4 min north along Chuo-dori avenue into Don Quijote Akihabara.
5 floors of souvenirs, matcha chocolates, skincare, and novelty gifts with tax-free checkout.

Hunt for vintage Japanese streetwear, sneakers, jacket thrifting, dried seafood, and stroll into Ueno Park.

simplifiedBullets.text: Stroll 10 min north along railway arches to Okachimachi / Ameyoko (or JR Yamanote 1 stop, ¥150).
Bargain-hunt for Japanese jackets, sneaker boutiques, dried fruit, and stroll into Ueno Park.

activities.transitSummary: Subway Ginza Line 5 min to Asakusa ➔ Walk 8 min to dinner
activities.note: Walk 2 min to Tokyo Metro Ueno Station ➔ Board Ginza Line 3 stops direct to Asakusa Station (5 min, ¥180) ➔ Walk 8 min to HALAL SAKURA for farewell dinner.

simplifiedBullets.text: Take Ginza Line 3 stops from Ueno to Asakusa (5 min, ¥180) ➔ Walk to HALAL SAKURA.
Celebrate your final night in Japan with delicious Halal sukiyaki, nabe hotpot, and ramen.

activities.note: Check out Hotel Tavinos Asakusa by 10:00am. Walk 6 min to Tokyo Metro Asakusa Station ➔ Board Ginza Line 3 stops to Ueno Station (5 min, ¥180) ➔ Walk through indoor underground connection (3 min, 180m) to Keisei Ueno Station (Skyliner Terminal).

simplifiedBullets.text: Check out of Hotel Tavinos by 10:00am with all bags.

simplifiedBullets.text: Store luggage in Keisei Ueno station coin lockers or roll bags along.
Enjoy coffee, light lunch, and pick up last-minute snacks at Ueno 3153 or Ameyoko entrance.

activities.transitSummary: Keisei Skyliner (41 min non-stop, 160 km/h, ¥2,570 pp)
activities.note: Enter Skyliner Gates at Keisei Ueno Station (Platform 1/2). Board Keisei Skyliner Express (12:40 departure). Race across the Chiba plain at 160 km/h on the Narita Sky Access Line — non-stop to Narita Airport Terminal 2·3 Station (36 min) and Terminal 1 Station (41 min) (¥2,570 / ~RM 75 pp).

simplifiedBullets.text: Board Skyliner Express (12:40 departure) at Keisei Ueno Platform 1/2.
Fastest route to Narita: 160 km/h non-stop across Chiba straight to Terminal 1 & 2 (36–41 min, ¥2,570).

activities.note: Take elevators from station platforms directly up to 4F International Departures concourse. Check in luggage at airline counters (Batik Air / Malaysia Airlines / AirAsia X). Clear security and automated immigration gates (approx 45 min). Browse terminal duty-free boutiques (Tokyo Banana, Royce' Chocolate, Shiroi Koibito cookies, Japanese tea).

simplifiedBullets.text: Take elevator up to 4F International Departures; drop luggage at airline counters (Batik Air / MAS / AirAsia).
Clear automated security gates, then shop duty-free treats: Tokyo Banana, Royce' Chocolate & Shiroi Koibito.
